12:Td0059,<p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-faff9ace-4cbb-45e1-bd87-d856d8f06287" style="">기아 타이거즈가 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-4012356d-f5c6-4662-9440-9ffaac0d3b46" style="">새 외국인 타자 패트릭 위즈덤과 계약했습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9907c692-05c3-458b-8a12-f7311b8134ff" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs11 se-ff-" id="SE-13ce56cc-0552-4d86-b674-66b66fdce01e" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://imnews.imbc.com/news/2024/sports/article/6670840_36466.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="프로야구 KIA, 새 외국인 타자로 패트릭 위즈덤 영입"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://imnews.imbc.com/news/2024/sports/article/6670840_36466.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        프로야구 KIA, 새 외국인 타자로 패트릭 위즈덤 영입
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        프로야구 우승팀 KIA가 올해 시카고 컵스에서 뛰었던 패트릭 위즈덤과 계약금 20만 달러, 연봉 80만 달러 등 100만 달러에 영입했습니다. KIA는 "위즈덤은 1루와 3루뿐 아...
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-73794700-c5d4-4034-97b6-f196443c859a" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-8d1ca886-d2ba-4bac-9083-acc28ffdca46" style="">3년 동안 팀과 함께한 소크라테스 브리토와는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1166273e-feba-47b0-a900-9ef9e4fd53d6" style="">헤어지게 된 것인데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d946bb59-2117-459f-bcd4-b06406b54932" style="">제가 예전에 포스트를 남겼듯이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-71c06b08-03c6-4f6c-976c-051db842aa4f" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-95958cd7-41bc-4314-80f2-fc723159aef3" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://blog.naver.com/dolja21/223501729255" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/png;base64,"
                        alt="소크라테스*에 대한 3가지 오해"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://blog.naver.com/dolja21/223501729255" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        소크라테스*에 대한 3가지 오해
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        이 형님 이야기 아니구요 이 형님 이야기도 아닙니다~ 기아 타이거즈 외국인 타자 소크라테스 브리또에 관...
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d080a659-0eb0-4bfe-9225-42d9fa8e9c1b" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-322374ea-7d94-49db-a481-7ce4ad79eb9c" style="">슬로우스타터로써의 문제점</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2b2fe26e-83e9-4c95-8a3f-9a4a01a9cdb0" style="">잘 알려지지 않았지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f876a5f9-7461-41b1-9709-a0f58614956d" style="">기대보다 못 미치는 수비 능력</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ea596875-43ff-402e-bc80-567f486d8386" style="">외국인 타자 치고는 아쉬운 장타력 등의</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-63c9adb4-1b6f-433e-a57a-c699515f2632" style="">한계를 극복하기 위한 대안으로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9b6ca81a-74ce-4f6f-9861-02149e399f45" style="">패트릭 위즈덤을 선택한 것으로 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-393ddd7d-489f-4357-b1ec-2e6b8837fff0" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-7d3f0c6e-4f5e-4623-947e-2d93e0efadec" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://youtu.be/xF7Gz_6upu0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="Patrick Wisdom homers for the Cardinals"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://youtu.be/xF7Gz_6upu0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        Patrick Wisdom homers for the Cardinals
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        4/24/15: Patrick Wisdom belts a two-run homer in Springfield's 12-5 loss to ArkansasCheck out http://www.MiLB.com/video for more!MiLB.com is the official sit...
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f766e34e-7388-4919-a16a-4d7016510f96" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-4f406900-7a31-4b68-a7b1-26eaf9714170" style="">이 선수 2012년 드래프트 1순위로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d6392868-8686-415c-8f53-c26fa9a13e28" style="">세인트루이스 카디널스에 지명받습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-c1ecd7c5-5c79-4cfd-8780-25ff057f0e95" style="">지명 당시에는 엄청난 기대주였다는 소리죠.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-60e8f791-0d94-4bc6-b28a-8d60ca4c48ee" style="">1991년생으로 소크라테스보다 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-71779974-e452-4b85-a282-b2bb4a4b793a" style="">오히려 1살 많습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-e64f528d-c6cb-424d-92f4-250599a702ff" style="">키는 188인데 소크라테스와 같네요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-49e90f07-7d1e-44f7-b069-e59d4d1cb03b" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-f0ac8fde-c9f8-4038-8a26-2de1527ac3c9" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZiVSPPgRBhg" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="Patrick Wisdom first Big League Plate apperiance"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZiVSPPgRBhg" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        Patrick Wisdom first Big League Plate apperiance
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2551ef7d-b39a-460b-9d79-3c73009c5e58" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-b659cea4-a1bd-43e9-877f-9b7a662c9d30" style="">지명은 2012년에 받았지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f27d9594-8ebb-495e-b646-6fa1da4da8b0" style="">MLB 데뷔는 2018년에 합니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ffb86934-9223-4500-9868-2c361093bef2" style="">위 영상에서 보시다시피 빅리그 데뷔 첫 안타는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-58ae39d2-4ae4-4777-b433-ad663499146d" style="">내야안타 였습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2b0f210e-7a56-44c6-8ed4-bcea2e589500" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs11 se-ff-" id="SE-e5e416b8-4c14-4563-b1ff-73ed78124939" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OCjHQCDFOYs" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="Patrick Wisdom's First Home Run as a Chicago Cub"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OCjHQCDFOYs" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        Patrick Wisdom's First Home Run as a Chicago Cub
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        Wisdom goes deep for the first time as a Cub
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-efafc4e4-f1be-4993-9fb3-62193f552ca3" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0bf745cb-8381-4f74-a84b-350c2841b4bd" style="">빅리그에서 홈런 88개를 때렸는데</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-607001b1-816e-46e8-911d-a99c37f9e13d" style="">대부분은 2020년에 이적한</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0b480557-b6e9-4e04-b522-9812a4ffae03" style="">시카고 컵스에서 기록했습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-7b6f6fa7-6f91-4d27-ae59-c5aedd8a34aa" style="">참고로 테스형은 MLB에서 총 5개의 홈런을</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ae3924a1-2689-438e-8aed-934757108968" style="">기록한 바 있습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21bfd79d-1484-4966-bfea-fb55e0be7344" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223720081757_0.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d053ef1e-816b-4df2-8fbe-265dcc4847fe" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-41f545f3-a20d-48cf-8c01-067469ab3d00" style="">MLB 주요 기록을 살펴보면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9637ce13-e540-46ad-b173-d27130f83b1c" style="">작년 리그 홈런왕인 NC의 맷 데이비슨과</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-71ea3f5e-1da6-4ad6-9bef-6b0dd67d0490" style="">비슷한 유형의 선수로 파악됩니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-64e7e1b7-ee60-48b2-9b78-ca8339264270" style="">주목할 만한 점은 삼진을 더 자주 당하긴 했지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-630844a6-bf4e-4ebe-bdbe-51f30cda40af" style="">데이비슨 보다 거포로서의 기록이 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-573cb975-783e-447f-a4d6-17e0f559b1c4" style="">더 좋았다는 점입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2a6f1c5d-4f0b-443f-95d6-bd7ea1084198" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223720081757_1.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-511166dd-efb5-4fba-8986-32406c0ede1c" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1e367125-8685-488d-800f-9ca7f27dd11c" style="">참고로 데이비슨 선수와 위즈덤 선수 동갑입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-74d88fea-6cbe-439b-8815-9d642fd82352" style="">맷 데이비슨의 경우 2020년부터</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-8a3dbf6a-c24f-4898-845d-427d242efd47" style="">MLB 출장 기회가 줄어들었고</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-62ea770c-4627-45f9-b1de-c8f407c319e7" style="">몇 년을 버티다가 한국에 왔지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f2a35f3f-8996-4895-8f79-18d85fc00f4f" style="">위즈덤은 2023년까지 3년 연속 20홈런을 치다가</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-6afb0a8a-e0b4-4dce-8b04-e82433fa78d0" style="">작년에 8개로 줄고 한국으로 왔습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-b2b9a61a-775a-4ba1-8a80-4ba4ba9f198c" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs11 se-ff-" id="SE-70134ec8-6db3-46ec-b3e5-8a2fd66d171f" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ezfL3YrMHv0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="Patrick Wisdom 2023 Home Runs"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ezfL3YrMHv0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        Patrick Wisdom 2023 Home Runs
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        All 23 of Wisdom's home runs in 2023
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-576d291b-a18d-4c63-ae89-d08e725cc81d" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5ff7c3b7-9e43-429a-b99f-be49dfa86169" style="">홈런 치는 것만으로 보면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a46a0c2b-640a-4cbf-8c3a-21ce7992718b" style="">왜 한국에 오지 하는 생각이 듭니다만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-463d07e5-4b99-4e08-897e-d8ca87e72981" style="">분명히 약점은 있습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-13f31eae-7379-48ad-b12d-7f522ddec28d" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223720081757_2.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-8b5f8b7b-f9a8-4ecb-b69f-1625f3131a26" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-4e5d74f6-1dcd-4502-beab-5c66b1c14781" style="">타율이 너무 떨어지는 선수였어요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-e4f973d5-d34f-4cd6-b102-1b030f4b2271" style="">물론 현대 야구에서 타율을 우선하는 선입견이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-b538ef7d-69ad-4acc-b3e5-e1b84e0c25bd" style="">많이 완화되긴 했지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-6ed9fa17-6c5f-43e7-b8f0-7f413d434c14" style="">2할이 겨우 넘는 타율을 보이는 선수를</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-414ffeef-1875-4132-896a-9794035782ec" style="">잘한다고 하기는 어렵죠.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-00e4f2dd-a732-4312-8d41-fa32b8a4429c" style="">그런데 이 점도 데이비슨과 비슷합니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-46082a66-18f5-42b3-a47b-ae89a5514491" style="">통산 빅리그 타율과 출루율이 거의 동일합니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-c0f31ba5-59a7-4505-a11c-2d9e8d0eea4d" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223720081757_3.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f07c8a57-09ea-4ce0-9eeb-a205b9b82de8" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-b759a969-8683-434b-a6a2-18259e69987e" style="">그럼에도 불구하고 미국을 떠나기 직전</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-135be3db-fe7c-4817-983c-c4cb100c7d91" style="">트리플A 성적을 보면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-4de9592d-8136-4150-a3d2-e6ac5a7e0b35" style="">데이비슨급 활약을 기대하게 만드는데요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-bf12036e-b5ec-43c4-8f52-e8532e10afca" style="">비록 타석수가 많이 적었지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-3e799c46-3d2c-4fc7-bff2-82df12a75173" style="">마이너리그에서는 더 보여줄게 없는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-918cbe51-e746-4c31-9095-22532fe582f5" style="">기록을 보였었습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ab912e74-e342-485f-a8db-9265882aa2f9" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1bcedc54-a26d-480a-a9e8-42257d9cec78" style="">

<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ce633bde-8eb7-422b-ac90-3152459668c6" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a7a1e74b-01b9-42b3-b8ae-85a9de846f09" style="">그렇다면 이 선수 수비는 어떨까요?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0a573f19-f9cf-4c89-a0e2-f1b2501e5a93" style="">당초에 소크라테스에게 아쉬웠던 점이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-34731134-69c0-4f22-a328-41c2bde21a16" style="">바로 수비였는데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0d9d619c-c537-430a-9ad8-3aa5aa1f7fca" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223720081757_4.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-87b5a0b9-a3c0-4886-851f-17d8d3b2052c" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-6c0aa310-1455-4e01-9b99-9f7bb83ac996" style="">사실 수비 강화를 논할 만큼의</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-78f092e8-53eb-4090-b8ac-0cd43b525918" style="">수비 능력을 보여준다고</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-b824e255-b45e-4944-afe9-a8162cbc0e0b" style="">보기는 어려울 것 같습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d981573b-be4d-4ca4-819f-cf1818f8a8c5" style="">이 선수를 1루로 보고 데려온 것으로 보입니다만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f76dd5cb-61e7-49d0-b17e-5c4f286ee0d2" style="">가장 핏이 맞는 위치는 3루입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-59530c2d-00a4-4b77-b865-7c15cb1aaccb" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-03cf9f2c-7291-45da-a283-6b2029ecb113" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">

<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0ee58986-b076-42bd-87e2-1329975a54f2" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-35ac2295-bab3-45c4-a0fd-231ca7ff1cf6" style="">그렇다고 이 선수가 3루 수비를</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-e1c50f49-aa2c-4f7a-8baf-078f2ad9d3f0" style="">골든글러버 급으로 잘하는 것도 아니라서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-47b5d802-3388-48e1-bc7f-34d366df081d" style="">유도영 - 1우혁으로의 수비 체질 개선에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-911532d4-b3b2-4b08-b405-0fff78745d63" style="">도움이 될 것으로 보이지는 않구요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ccd8cafd-17b6-47ca-a104-ccfcf5e4cc73" style="">그냥 1루수로 쓸 것 같습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ffaf746b-5329-4f01-8fcd-e98e32df5ed4" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f73044ba-3284-4f92-a134-9d9df2093214" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-e137b87e-af1f-497d-bdc6-bea9521a73db" style="">어찌 보면 제일 중요한 점!</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-09c7573b-0feb-49de-986d-8750caf433bd" style="">이 선수 계절 타는지</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-dbacddc3-4b7b-4572-943f-b6be0650d10a" style="">알아봤습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-3d3245eb-3f6f-4e56-a93f-00e805c2623f" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223720081757_5.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-28332f86-c65d-4fb3-a67f-893adff87052" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-bc5bc4d9-31d6-445b-95f5-89dea9dad9a7" style="">MLB 기록만 봐서는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-6ba99e59-4b4f-4e30-be97-ac16eed33e7d" style="">오히려 봄에 더 잘 합니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-7cabe6e2-c32b-4aac-9a58-a3622e558c75" style="">물론 소크라테스도 미국에 있을 때는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-62b9fa65-4544-47f2-90b2-89c3efbbc642" style="">계절 타는 선수가 아니었다고</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-51d3ee3b-a71b-4071-9f8e-07e472c3f47f" style="">이미 말씀드린 바가 있었죠.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0e35a776-22a4-499b-b9f1-f44368440cd8" style="">한국에 오면 또 모릅니다~</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-30dc0b7b-2f9d-49ac-9243-3ceba6c99143" style="">마지막으로 부상 이력 한 번</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d70e65dd-6f0b-4bbb-999c-43e06a253397" style="">체크해 보죠</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-bd1c4e38-06f2-48b7-a0f8-b2e726418c33" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223720081757_6.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-c9639118-5066-4239-9467-d0eb55276254" style="">흠... 부상 이력이 화려하네요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-573fac1e-3424-4a03-bf7d-f462efa04e83" style="">이 점은 분명히 이 선수의 리스크로 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-3ca69e5f-7d8c-44ae-803f-5a4981e29a44" style="">또한 비록 폭망하긴 했지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-45b3a837-a851-46e9-908a-cf6aa11d965d" style="">데이비슨이 일본을 거쳐 한국으로 온 반면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-8deda000-682e-4266-bc5c-dace99bde04b" style="">위즈덤은 바로 한국으로 오는 점에서 볼 때</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-20b582b9-d7e9-4d69-8178-b82406afb597" style="">아시아 야구에 적응해야 하는 시간이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d365916c-f35e-4e0b-a78f-953c6543be3b" style="">조금 더 길 수도 있을 것 같습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-4be4da00-cbae-46ea-b10e-03040da611c2" style="">홈런을 많이 쳐야 하는 선수</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-812f6c38-36af-4290-a5d5-c507b50d1099" style="">수비는 송구만 잘 잡아주기를 바라야</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-4e160dea-a0ba-4a4d-966f-e2ed3f35dbf9" style="">초반에 적응 시간 필요할 수도</span><br/></p>
